comment: GYM-GATE TRIGGER WIRING (data level; the host applies it). The two Kanto gyms whose availability consumes story flags - gym 3 (ss_anne_cleared) and gym 6 (saffron_access + silph_co_cleared) - get a production trigger record each. The host's gym-leader interaction works like this: (1) evaluate gate.checker against the live state; if it refuses, present gate refusal descriptions (checker returns them as 'unmet') and DO NOT start the event script; (2) if it allows, load the event script, overwrite the battle step's badge_count with the live GLOBAL badge count (PUWGymProgression.badge_count(state)) - step data is host-supplied by the project's own convention (the Oak fixture's picks work the same way) - and run it; (3) on the script's win branch, call on_win.caller with on_win.args so the badge award goes through the stitch's own gate-checked path. The event scripts ALSO carry use_campaign_gate on their battle steps, so even a host that skips step (1) cannot start these battles early: PUWBattleEntry refuses and the runner halts with an error. Requirements below are copied from data/gym_requirements.json (the bound record file) - that file stays the single source of truth; this file only wires its consumers.
source: data/gym_requirements.json (records kanto_gym_3_surge, kanto_gym_6_sabrina); checkers PUWGymRequirements.can_start_gym / PUWCampaignStitch.can_start_gym_battle (bound); battle door PUWBattleEntry.start_gym_battle (bound).
